units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:3">Targ. Esth. VIII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. B’shall., p. 82ᵃ (translating <cite ref="Exodus 18">Ex. XVIII</cite>, 11ᵇ) <he>במחשבה דחַשְׁבוּן איתחשב להון</he> what they had planned (against Israel) was planned against them.
Sabb. 3ᵃ קא חֲשִׁיב he counts in; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָשִׁיב, pl. חֲשִׁיבִין = h. חָשׁוּב, v. preced.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 4:19">Targ. Y. Ex. IV, 19</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 8b:6">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ את וכ׳</he> thou hast been found worthy to be seized (to suffer) for etc.
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:18">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן ח׳ וכ׳</he> who is highly esteemed in that world (the hereafter)?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 21:11">Targ. Jer. XXI, 11</cite>.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 25:27">Targ. O. Lev. XXV, 27</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Megillah 11b:6">Meg. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>חַשִּׁיב ועייל וכ׳</he> count, and include in their place &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 94a:7">Pes. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא חַשְּׁבֵי דקדמא וכ׳</he> because they also counted the distances which one walks before dawn and after sunset.

<cite ref="Shabbat 74a:1">Sabb. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>וליחַשֵּׁב וכ׳</he> let him also count the act of pounding; <cite ref="Shabbat 6b">ib. 6ᵇ</cite>; a. e. <he>ולִחְשׁוֹב</he> (Pe.); a. fr. [Y. Pes. IV, end, 31ᶜ <he>מחשבנא</he> v. <cite ref="H01846"><he>חֲשַׂךְ</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 50:20">Targ. O. Gen. L, 20</cite>.—Pesik. l. c., v. supra.
Targ. Ps. L, 23; a. fr.—[Targ. Prov. XXIX, 11 מֵיחֲשַׁב Ms. (ed. Lag. מחשב, Var. מאשב) is respected (v. Pesh. a. l.; ed. Wil. מאכה v. מְאַךְ).]
